title: Provider-backed autonomous execution stabilization

stabilizationRoute.reason: Ensure one deterministic accepted cycle without secret exposure while preserving governance and evidence flow

checks.detail: Live API diagnostics confirmed external provider routes were unconfigured and local model route was unreachable in the active environment.
Mission creation returned awaiting_approval and execution only started after explicit approval.
Mission output persisted accepted evaluation (decision accepted, score 100) with execution, evaluation and evidence IDs.
Terminal mission output includes missionResult.status=completed and missionResult.cause=execution.
Learning engine persisted observation/proposal linkage with matching mission, execution, evaluation and evidence identifiers.

constraintsRespected: No provider secret was printed or persisted in evidence files.
No destructive operation and no history rewrite.
No automatic provider retry was performed.
